query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleDate,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as dateOnly
FROM sales s
INNER JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE p.name = 'Baly Maça Verde 2l'
  AND s.saleDate >= '2025-12-01'
  AND s.status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY s.id, s.saleDate
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
